name: Cinema Navy
tagline: heditor's cinema: navy stage, gold-bordered camera card, Anton captions on a yellow pill, freeze → turn → payoff.

motion.direction: heditor `cinema`. The speaker lives in a gold-bordered card on a navy stage; captions are Anton, 1–3 words, the spoken word black on a `#ffd84d` pill. Spine: frame-0 hook (no intro) → the common belief → a FREEZE on the wrong idea (`strikeLine` through it, `stamp` verdict) → diagnosis in cards → the TURN: one 250 px word slams in (`posterText`, 2 words max) → payoff slots with a `counter` on every number → CTA chapterCard in the last 4 s. Punch-ins 1.12–1.2 on hits, 6–10 hits per minute; cyan `goldd` only for the explanation line, gold for the hook line. Hard cuts; never cover the face.
